item.title: Rain, Snow likely across Jammu Kashmir, Heavy spell forecast in higher reaches
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 19: A prolonged wet spell is expected to affect Jammu and Kashmir from January 19 to January 25, with generally cloudy conditions and intermittent light rain and snow at many places, the MET Centre Srinagar said on Monday. item.title: Kashmir continues to Freeze as IMD predicts Snowfall, Rainfall
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 20: Minimum temperatures across Kashmir plunged below the freezing mark at most locations, with Sonamarg emerging as the coldest place in the Valley at minus 6.2 degrees Celsius, according to data compiled by Kashmir Weather. Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 3.4 degrees Celsius, while the mercury at Srinagar airport dropped to minus 4.4 degrees. item.title: LG Manoj Sinha inaugurates redeveloped Amira Kadal pedestrian bridge in Srinagar
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 20: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Tuesday inaugurated the revamped Amira Kadal in Srinagar. The pedestrian bridge has been redeveloped under the Srinagar Smart City Project, officials said. item.title: Tight Security deployed on NH-44, Kulgam ahead of Republic Day
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 21: Ahead of Republic Day celebrations, Kulgam Police have intensified security measures along the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) and across various parts of Kulgam district to thwart any attempts to disturb peace and public order. A senior official said that the heightened security drive is being carried out on the directions of SSP Kulgam, Shri Anayat Ali Choudhary (IPS).
